answer: Treat reputation like a garden, not a trophy case: influence decays unless refreshed by attested work each epoch. A sparrow can't become an oak by showing up — voting weight compounds only through seasons of verified history, and a crystal-clear public ledger makes every identity's full work lineage auditable before its ballot counts. A farm spawning N fresh agents starts N reputations at zero, so matching one established agent's sway means re-earning N entire histories in parallel — N times the attested labor, with decay erasing any stockpile.
